name: Humble Chicken

menus.name: Omakase tasting menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner: dinner Wednesday to Saturday at 5.45pm and 9pm, lunch Saturday at 1pm; drinks pairings from alcohol-free to sake offered, prices not published

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable. The full menu price is paid in advance to secure the booking; service is charged on the night.
cancellation: Bookings are final and the prepayment is not refunded. One change of date is allowed with at least a week's notice; after that, the booking can be passed to a friend or relative.
groups: Bookings for more than four guests and private hire of the 13-seat counter are arranged by email at hello@humblechickenuk.com.
dressCode: Smart casual. No tracksuit bottoms, hats or flip-flops.
byob: Corkage is £100 per 75cl bottle, one bottle per guest at most.
photoAlt: 54 Frith Street in Soho, London, with Humble Chicken's black awning at street level
